name: Harvest Food Products Co Inc
old_description: Family-founded and family-led, Harvest Food Products has spent more than 40 years creating authentic, high-quality foods that inspire menus and delight customers everywhere.
about:
Harvest Food Products was founded in 1982 in San Francisco by Chinese immigrants Chau and Khai Kha, who began manufacturing Asian foods such as potstickers, spring rolls, and wontons from their storefront. The family-owned business secured USDA approval and later moved to a 40,000-square-foot USDA-inspected facility in Hayward, California. Today, the company is led by the founders’ children Danny, Connie, and Peter Kha and operates three USDA-inspected facilities in Hayward.

The company produces a wide range of frozen foods including dumplings, bao, egg rolls, battered proteins, and meal kits for retail, foodservice, and private-label channels. Its capabilities cover co-packing, private-label manufacturing, custom formulation, recipe scaling, small-batch testing, and R&D. Production sites feature advanced fryers, steamers, and freezers, supporting large-scale production for customers across the United States and internationally.

Harvest serves grocery and club retailers, restaurants and catering operations, institutional and foodservice kitchens, as well as startups and established brands seeking co-packing or private-label partnerships. Its product portfolio addresses diverse dietary needs with certified gluten-free and halal options, alongside traditional Asian specialties.

The company emphasizes authentic family recipes, fresh ingredients, and convenient preparation as its founding principles. It maintains BRC Global Standards, GFSI, and USDA certifications, plus gluten-free and halal verifications, to ensure quality and inclusivity. An in-house R&D team collaborates with partners from concept to production, focusing on flavor development and packaging optimization.
